title: Workflow (parallix) optional override config
description: Optional per-repository override for the workflow runtime. The tool ships code-owned defaults and runs with no config file; create workflow.config.json only to override a default. Every section and field is optional and is merged over the built-in defaults. Run `px config` to print the effective configuration.

tasks.description: Task tracker and on-disk task storage.

stateMap.description: Repo-relative path to the virtual-to-actual Backlog state map.

storage.description: Task storage directory (string) or an object with tasksDir/completedDir.

missions.description: Mission document layout and branch/worktree conventions.

branchPrefix.description: Branch name prefix for missions, e.g. mission/.

primaryBranch.description: Primary branch override if not auto-detected.

integrate.description: Optional post-integrate hook. When postIntegrateCommand is unset, `px integrate` behaves exactly as it does without this section.

postIntegrateCommand.description: Shell command run at most once, from the base checkout, after a successful non-dry-run `px integrate`. Receives INTEGRATE_HOOK_SLUG, INTEGRATE_HOOK_BASE_WORKTREE, INTEGRATE_HOOK_BASE_BRANCH, and INTEGRATE_HOOK_VARIANT as environment variables.

review.description: Review surface. An unset provider keeps the lifecycle running without a mirrored review provider; set provider to 'forgejo' (with baseUrl, remote, repo) to enable Forgejo, or 'none' to run without one.

agents.description: Agent adapter settings. Agent launcher commands are resolved from PATH and configured via operator-local environment, not this file.

maxConcurrentCustom.description: Optional maximum simultaneously running custom-agent instances. When unset, custom-agent launches are unlimited; configured values must be positive integers.

models.description: Optional per-agent-family LLM model override, keyed by agent family name (e.g. codex, claude, gemini, glm, vibe, custom). Each value is the model identifier passed to that agent's CLI. A family that is not listed sends no model parameter, so the agent uses its own default. There is no 'default' key.

runners.description: Runner selection for agent families that support multiple backends. Currently only 'custom' is supported, with values 'opencode' or 'pi'.

custom.description: Selects the launcher backend for the custom agent family. Defaults to 'opencode' if not specified.

subagents.description: Operational limits for subagent spawning within an agent.

maxParallel.description: Maximum number of parallel subagent forks. When unset, null, or zero, no limit is applied.
